newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - JANUARY 14.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - JANUARY 14.

text.p: Turnover in kerb bond trade through the Warsaw Stock Exchange was at 13 million zlotys on Tuesday, slightly down from Monday's 13.8 million zlotys.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 9,990 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2000 traded at 86.75 zlotys.
* 4,000 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2001 traded at 80.35 zlotys.
